The *Sandhitattheraapadāna* (Tha Ap 218) is a biographical verse narrative preserved in the Therāpadāna section of the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. The text recounts the past deeds and spiritual attainment of the thera Sandhita. SuttaCentral indexes five modern translations across five languages for this entry [SuttaCentral].

While no external parallels are listed in SuttaCentral or found with high confidence in other canonical languages by DharmaNexus, automated analysis records twelve Pali-internal text-reuse matches across three texts [DharmaNexus]. The text shares segments closely with *Sandhitattheragāthā* (Thag 2.49), where verses in §0.2–2.4 overlap significantly, as well as with the commentary *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* (Paṭhamo bhāgo) across eight matches [DharmaNexus]. In addition, formulaic or narrative material in §3.3–6.1 is shared with another Apadāna text, the *Ṭhitañjaliyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 81) [DharmaNexus].
